verdict.rationale: The evidence does not document any per-agent spend caps, usage limits, or a way to instantly revoke an agent's payment authority. The closest item is the ACP delegated token, a single-use, merchant-configured nonce with amount and time restrictions. That is a per-transaction credential property set by the merchant, not a user-facing cap or revocation control for an agent, so it is adjacent and earns no credit. The toolkit's human-oversight guidance is advice, not a feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set per-agent spend caps and usage limits and revoke an agent's payment authority instantly
